resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts quotes the July 10, 1935 annual report entry for the 100-foot replacement; Willhite places the replacement in its 1934 paragraph. The story follows the dated report and notes the Willhite date.

Forest Lookouts and Willhite say the lookout was lost in the 1980s; Friends of the Bear River Refuge dates the flood disaster to 1983. The story uses 1983 for the flood and the 1980s for the tower loss.

notes_for_editor: Forest Lookouts (Kemnow) and Willhite share almost the same wording on the 1980s loss and may not be independent. The HQ coordinate 41.47947, -112.26729 comes from FFLA; it sits about 10 miles west of the Perry coordinate, and no source gives coordinates for the HQ tower, so it is unchecked. Willhite photo captions (for example Entrance gate and the 100 foot tower) were not used because no image URLs were captured. A refuge Facebook post, seen only as a search snippet and not readable through fetch_text, describes a second tower of over 100 feet installed in the 1950s or 1960s and knocked down by 1980s floods, plus a current tower. That may conflict with the 1935 dates and should be checked before publication; it was not used.
